diagnosis.cause: The active recovery intentionally set validation_interval_steps=0 to avoid the previously observed rank-0 Comet asset-upload boundary stall. Its full-96 validation loop was deferred until after training, so validation assets could not appear live even though training scalars continued.

repair.method: Two independent one-GPU validation-only sidecars consume atomic checkpoints while the two-GPU trainer remains untouched.
repair.comet_behavior: Both sidecars append full-96 images, id_sim/text_sim, the compact face-quality curves, and per-image CSV assets to the original immutable Comet experiment.
repair.local_completion_markers: After a successful validation event, the sidecar publishes the 96 images and face-quality output into the main run directory so the trainer's deferred post-training loop skips that completed step.

failed_startup_attempts.outcome: Failed during read-only shell preflight because the sidecar output directory did not exist; no model load and no Comet write.
